title: Arogya Shield Plus — Product Overview
content: Arogya Shield Plus is a comprehensive health insurance plan offered by ShieldCare Insurance. It provides coverage for hospitalization, day-care procedures, pre and post-hospitalization expenses, AYUSH treatments, maternity benefits, and restoration of sum insured. Available in three tiers: Silver (₹5L), Gold (₹10L), and Platinum (₹25L) sum insured.

title: Premium Schedule — Age Band Pricing
content: Silver plan (₹5L): Age 18-35: ₹4,200/yr, Age 36-45: ₹6,100/yr, Age 46-55: ₹9,800/yr, Age 56-65: ₹14,500/yr. Gold plan (₹10L): Age 18-35: ₹7,500/yr, Age 36-45: ₹11,200/yr, Age 46-55: ₹17,600/yr, Age 56-65: ₹26,000/yr. Platinum plan (₹25L): Age 18-35: ₹15,000/yr, Age 36-45: ₹22,500/yr, Age 46-55: ₹36,000/yr, Age 56-65: ₹52,000/yr. All premiums are exclusive of 18% GST. Family floater adds 20% to base premium. Senior loading (60-65): additional 20%.

title: Eligibility Rules — Age and Residency
content: ELIGIBLE: Indian residents and NRIs aged 18 to 65 years. INELIGIBLE for new enrollment: below 18 or above 65 years as primary member. SENIOR LOADING: Members aged 60-65 require a pre-policy medical examination at an approved diagnostic center and are subject to 20% premium loading. Existing members can renew for life — there is no exit age once enrolled. Dependent children covered up to age 25 under family floater.

title: Pre-Existing Disease (PED) Waiting Period
content: Pre-existing diseases (PED) are conditions diagnosed or treated within 48 months prior to policy inception. Waiting period rules: Silver and Gold plans — 24-month PED waiting period. Platinum plan — 12-month PED waiting period. After the waiting period, all PED conditions are fully covered with no sub-limit. Mandatory disclosure: Failure to disclose a known PED may result in claim rejection. Common PEDs: diabetes, hypertension, cardiac conditions, thyroid disorders, asthma.

title: Day-Care Procedures Coverage
content: Arogya Shield Plus covers over 550 approved day-care procedures that do not require 24-hour hospitalization due to technological advances. These include: cataract surgery, chemotherapy, dialysis, lithotripsy, dental surgery requiring anesthesia, laparoscopic procedures, and radiation therapy. No sub-limit applies to day-care procedures. The procedure must be performed at a network hospital or approved day-care center.

title: Room Rent and ICU Limits
content: Silver plan: Shared room / General ward coverage. Room rent capped at ₹2,500/day. Gold plan: Single AC room coverage. No room rent cap — room rent is fully covered. Platinum plan: Suite or deluxe room covered. No room rent cap. ICU charges: covered in full across all plans. If patient opts for a higher room category than covered, proportionate deduction applies to all associated charges.

title: Maternity and Newborn Coverage
content: Maternity benefit is available under Gold and Platinum plans after a 9-month waiting period from policy inception. Coverage includes: normal delivery (₹50,000), cesarean delivery (₹75,000), pre and post-natal expenses (₹5,000), newborn baby covered from birth for 90 days under mother's policy. Maternity is not covered under the Silver plan. IVF and surrogacy are excluded.

title: AYUSH Treatment Coverage
content: Arogya Shield Plus covers Ayurveda, Yoga, Unani, Siddha, and Homeopathy (AYUSH) treatments under all plans when treatment is taken in a government-recognized AYUSH hospital. Coverage is subject to the overall sum insured. Outpatient AYUSH consultations are not covered — only inpatient treatment requiring hospitalization is eligible.

title: Restoration Benefit
content: If the sum insured is exhausted during the policy year, the Restoration Benefit automatically reinstates 100% of the base sum insured once per policy year. The restored amount can be used for any subsequent hospitalization, including the same illness. Restoration is available across Gold and Platinum plans only. Silver plan has 50% restoration.

title: No-Claim Bonus (NCB)
content: No-Claim Bonus rewards policyholders who do not make a claim in a policy year. NCB structure: 10% increase in sum insured for each claim-free year, up to a maximum of 50% of base sum insured. NCB does not increase the premium — it increases the coverage amount. If a claim is made, the NCB accumulated is reduced by 50% for that year. NCB applies to all three plan tiers.

title: Cashless Claim Process
content: Cashless claims are available at any of ShieldCare's 10,000+ network hospitals across India. Process: 1. Contact the network hospital's insurance desk at least 4 hours before planned hospitalization (or immediately for emergencies). 2. Show your ShieldCare health card and photo ID. 3. Hospital submits pre-authorization request to ShieldCare TPA. 4. ShieldCare approves pre-authorization within 1 hour (emergencies) or 4 hours (planned). 5. At discharge, sign the cashless settlement form — no upfront payment required for approved amounts.

title: Reimbursement Claim Process
content: Reimbursement claims apply when treatment is taken at a non-network hospital or when cashless is not used. Process: 1. Collect all original bills, discharge summary, prescriptions, and lab reports. 2. Submit claim form within 30 days of discharge. 3. Attach: completed claim form, original bills, discharge summary, doctor prescriptions, diagnosis report. 4. ShieldCare processes within 7-14 working days. 5. Approved amount transferred to registered bank account. Pre-authorization is not required for reimbursement.

title: Hospital Network and Coverage
content: ShieldCare has a network of 10,000+ empanelled hospitals across India, including 500+ hospitals in Tier 1 cities and 3,000+ in Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities. Key network hospitals: Apollo, Fortis, Max, Manipal, Narayana Health, AIIMS (for reimbursement), Aster, Columbia Asia. Hospital network list available at www.shieldcare.in/hospitals. Helpline for network queries: 1800-XXX-XXXX.

title: Exclusions — What is NOT Covered
content: Key exclusions under Arogya Shield Plus: 1. Cosmetic and aesthetic treatments. 2. Dental treatments (except following an accident requiring hospitalization). 3. Vision correction (spectacles, contact lenses, LASIK). 4. Self-inflicted injuries or suicide attempts. 5. War and nuclear perils. 6. Substance abuse and alcohol-related conditions. 7. Pregnancy (Silver plan only; Gold/Platinum have maternity after waiting period). 8. Experimental treatments not approved by medical authorities. 9. OPD consultations and medicines (except as part of hospitalization). 10. Infertility treatments including IVF.

title: FAQ — Can I add family members mid-term?
content: Family members can be added to the policy only at the time of renewal, not mid-term. Exception: a newborn baby can be added within 90 days of birth without waiting for renewal. A spouse can be added at renewal by converting from individual to family floater. Adding members at renewal does not affect the policy anniversary date.

title: FAQ — Pre and Post Hospitalization Expenses
content: Pre-hospitalization expenses: covered for 30 days before the date of hospitalization. Post-hospitalization expenses: covered for 60 days after the date of discharge. This includes doctor consultations, diagnostic tests, medicines, and follow-up treatments directly related to the hospitalization condition. OPD consultations unrelated to the hospitalized condition are not covered.

title: FAQ — Section 80D Tax Benefits
content: Health insurance premiums paid for Arogya Shield Plus are eligible for tax deduction under Section 80D of the Income Tax Act. Deduction limits: Self and family (below 60): up to ₹25,000/year. Self and family (60+): up to ₹50,000/year. Parents (below 60): additional ₹25,000. Parents (60+): additional ₹50,000. Maximum total deduction: ₹1,00,000/year (if self is 60+ and parents are 60+). Deduction is available for both old and new tax regimes.

title: Objection — Premium is too expensive
content: Response: One hospitalization in a private hospital in a metro city can cost ₹2 to ₹5 Lakh or more. Health insurance converts this unpredictable large cost into a small, predictable annual premium. Silver plan starts at ₹4,200/year (₹350/month) — less than a single restaurant meal per month. Additionally, the premium qualifies for Section 80D tax deduction, effectively reducing your out-of-pocket cost by 20-30% if you are in the 20-30% tax bracket. Consider it the cost of financial protection, not an expense.

title: Objection — I am young and healthy, I don't need insurance
content: Response: Premiums are at their absolute lowest when you are young and healthy. The same Gold plan coverage costs 2-3x more when purchased in your 50s compared to your 30s. Enrolling young also starts your waiting period clock immediately — so any future health conditions will be covered sooner. Medical inflation in India is 12-15% per year, making future premiums significantly higher. Accidents are covered from Day 1 — youth does not eliminate accident risk.

title: Objection — My employer already provides group insurance
content: Response: Employer group health insurance has significant limitations: (1) Coverage typically ends the day you leave the job — leaving you uninsured during job transitions. (2) Coverage amounts are usually low (₹1-3L), insufficient for serious illness in a private hospital. (3) No No-Claim Bonus or accumulated benefits — each year resets. (4) Cannot customize coverage for your specific family needs. Personal health insurance from Arogya Shield Plus complements your employer policy, provides portability, and builds lifelong coverage.

title: Objection — I found a cheaper plan elsewhere
content: Response: Lower premium plans typically come with significant trade-offs: room rent caps (which proportionately reduce ALL claim amounts), sub-limits on specific treatments, higher co-payments, smaller hospital networks, and lower claim settlement ratios. Arogya Shield Plus Gold has no room rent cap, covers 550+ day-care procedures, has a 97.2% claim settlement ratio, and a 10,000+ network hospital coverage. We recommend comparing the claim settlement ratio and policy exclusions, not just the premium.

title: Portability — Switching from Another Insurer
content: Arogya Shield Plus accepts portability from any IRDAI-registered health insurer. Portability benefits: (1) Waiting period credit — existing waiting period served with previous insurer is carried over. (2) No-Claim Bonus carried over proportionally. (3) PED waiting period served with old insurer is credited. Portability request must be made at least 45 days before policy renewal with the previous insurer. Submit: old policy documents, last 3 years' premium receipts, and a portability request form.

title: Free Look Period
content: Upon receiving the Arogya Shield Plus policy document, the policyholder has a 15-day free look period to review the terms and conditions. If dissatisfied for any reason, the policy can be returned within 15 days for a full refund of premium, minus: (a) proportionate risk premium for coverage period, (b) medical examination costs if incurred, (c) stamp duty charges. The free look period does not apply to renewals, only to new policies.

title: Emergency Hospitalization Protocol
content: For emergency hospitalization at a network hospital: 1. Proceed directly to the hospital emergency ward — no prior authorization needed. 2. Inform the insurance desk within 24 hours of admission (or as soon as medically feasible). 3. The hospital will submit post-facto authorization. 4. ShieldCare approves within 1 hour of receiving the request. For emergency at a non-network hospital: admit and stabilize first, then initiate reimbursement claim within 30 days of discharge. Emergency helpline: 1800-XXX-XXXX (24/7).

title: Mental Health and Psychiatric Coverage
content: As mandated by IRDAI and the Mental Healthcare Act 2017, Arogya Shield Plus covers mental health conditions including: hospitalization for psychiatric treatment, in-patient treatment for depression, anxiety disorders, bipolar disorder, schizophrenia, and substance abuse rehabilitation. Coverage is on par with physical illness hospitalization — same sum insured applies. OPD psychiatric consultations are not covered.

title: Organ Donor Expenses
content: Arogya Shield Plus covers medical expenses incurred by the organ donor for the harvesting procedure when the insured person is the recipient. The donor's hospitalization expenses for the organ donation surgery are covered up to the insured's sum insured. The donor does not need to be a policyholder. This coverage applies to kidney, liver, heart, cornea, and other IRDAI-approved organ transplants.

title: Co-Payment Clause
content: Standard Arogya Shield Plus plans have zero co-payment for members below 60 years. For members aged 60-65: 10% co-payment applies to all claims. For Platinum plan members, the co-payment is waived for all ages. Co-payment means the policyholder bears that percentage of the claim, and ShieldCare pays the rest. Example: ₹1 Lakh claim with 10% co-payment — policyholder pays ₹10,000, ShieldCare pays ₹90,000.

title: FAQ — Policy Renewal and Grace Period
content: Arogya Shield Plus policy must be renewed before the expiry date to maintain continuity of coverage. Grace period: 30 days from the expiry date for renewal without losing continuity benefits. If renewed within grace period: no waiting periods restart, NCB is maintained. If policy lapses beyond 30 days: treated as new policy — all waiting periods restart, NCB is lost. Renewal reminder sent 45 days before expiry via email and SMS.

title: FAQ — Ambulance Charges
content: Arogya Shield Plus covers ambulance charges for emergency transportation to the nearest network hospital. Coverage: Road ambulance up to ₹3,000 per hospitalization. Air ambulance: covered under Platinum plan up to ₹2.5 Lakh per hospitalization for life-threatening emergencies. Air ambulance is not covered under Silver and Gold plans. Ambulance charges must be supported by original ambulance bills and discharge summary confirming emergency.

title: Cashless at Non-Network Hospital — Emergency Exception
content: ShieldCare offers emergency cashless facility at non-network hospitals if the network hospital is more than 10 km away or unavailable in the area. The policyholder must call the 24/7 emergency helpline (1800-XXX-XXXX) to activate this. Pre-authorization is granted within 30 minutes for genuine emergencies. Post-emergency, within 48 hours, the hospital must submit required documents. This facility is not available for planned hospitalizations.

title: Critical Illness Rider — Optional Add-on
content: The Critical Illness Rider is an optional add-on available with Gold and Platinum plans. It pays a lump-sum benefit upon first diagnosis of 36 covered critical illnesses including: cancer, heart attack, stroke, kidney failure, major organ transplant, multiple sclerosis, paralysis, and coma. Lump-sum payout: ₹10L (Gold) or ₹25L (Platinum). Benefit is paid in addition to regular hospitalization claim. Rider premium: approximately 15-20% of base premium.

title: OPD Outpatient Benefit — Platinum Only
content: Platinum plan policyholders have access to an OPD (Outpatient) benefit of ₹10,000 per year. This covers: doctor consultation fees (up to ₹500/consultation), diagnostic tests (up to ₹3,000/test), prescribed medicines (up to ₹5,000/year). OPD benefit is not available under Silver and Gold plans. Claims are processed via reimbursement within 30 days of submission. Cosmetic consultations are excluded.

title: NRI Eligibility and Policy Terms
content: Non-Resident Indians (NRIs) are eligible for Arogya Shield Plus if they hold an Indian passport. Coverage is valid for hospitalizations in India only. Premium must be paid from an NRO/NRE/FCNR account or Indian bank account. NRI policyholders must provide: passport copy, visa/OCI card, and Indian address for correspondence. Claims are settled in INR. NRIs above 60 are subject to the same medical examination and senior loading as resident Indians.

title: 30-Day Initial Waiting Period
content: All Arogya Shield Plus policies have a 30-day initial waiting period from policy inception, during which no claims are payable except for accidental injuries. This means: if you are hospitalized within 30 days of buying the policy for a non-accidental illness, the claim will not be covered. After 30 days, all illnesses are covered subject to other waiting periods (PED, specific illness waiting periods). This waiting period applies only to new policies, not renewals.

title: Specific Disease Waiting Periods
content: Certain diseases have a 24-month waiting period from policy inception regardless of pre-existing status: hernia, hydrocele, cataract, tonsillitis, varicose veins, sinusitis, and joint replacement surgery. These conditions are covered from the 3rd policy year onwards. However, if the cataract or hernia surgery is being performed as a day-care procedure within the first 2 years and it is clearly NOT a pre-existing condition, it may be covered subject to underwriter review.

title: FAQ — Claim Rejection and Grievance Redressal
content: If a claim is rejected, ShieldCare provides: (1) Written rejection letter with specific reason within 30 days. (2) Right to file a grievance with ShieldCare Grievance Cell (grievance@shieldcare.in). (3) Grievance resolution within 15 working days. (4) If unsatisfied, escalate to IRDAI Bima Bharosa portal (bimabharosa.irdai.gov.in). (5) Further escalation to Insurance Ombudsman (free, no lawyer needed) for claims up to ₹30L. ShieldCare's 97.2% claim settlement ratio reflects commitment to fair claims.

title: Digital Health Features — Teleconsultation and App
content: Arogya Shield Plus Gold and Platinum plans include: (1) Unlimited teleconsultations with MBBS/MD doctors via the ShieldCare app — 24/7 availability. (2) Digital health card for cashless hospital access. (3) Claims tracking via app — real-time status updates. (4) Annual health check-up reminder and report storage. (5) ShieldCare app available on iOS and Android. Teleconsultation is not covered under the Silver plan.

title: Sum Insured Enhancement at Renewal
content: Policyholders can request a sum insured enhancement at renewal (upgrading from Silver to Gold, or Gold to Platinum). Rules: (1) Enhancement is subject to fresh underwriting — medical examination may be required depending on age. (2) The enhanced sum insured portion is subject to applicable waiting periods as a new policy for that incremental amount only. (3) Original sum insured retains its continuity benefits. (4) Enhancement requests must be submitted 30 days before renewal.

title: HIV/AIDS and Other STI Coverage
content: Following IRDAI guidelines, Arogya Shield Plus covers HIV/AIDS and other sexually transmitted infections (STIs) for hospitalization treatment. Coverage includes antiretroviral therapy if hospitalization is required, treatment of AIDS-defining illnesses requiring hospitalization, and HIV-related complications requiring surgery. OPD treatment, regular medication refills, and preventive treatment are not covered. Coverage applies subject to standard policy terms and waiting periods.

title: FAQ — What happens if I miss a premium payment?
content: If you miss the premium payment on the due date: (1) A 30-day grace period is provided for annual premium policies. (2) For monthly premium payment option: a 15-day grace period applies. (3) During the grace period, coverage continues. (4) If premium is not paid within the grace period: the policy lapses and coverage ceases. (5) To reinstate a lapsed policy within 6 months of lapse: pay outstanding premium plus penalty. (6) After 6 months: policy cannot be reinstated — must apply as new policy with fresh waiting periods.
